description: Generates sound variations for an event (spends credits: refused until the user approved the cost in the conversation, see approve_spending). Without prompt/duration/loop, uses the event's. LOOP OR ONE-SHOT, decided from what the sound is in the game: a LOOP is anything that lasts while something keeps happening and the game plays on repeat: ambience and weather, music, engines and machines, fire burning, flowing water, AND movement cycles: footsteps, walking, running, crawling, galloping, sustained wing flapping, rolling. Footsteps are a walk cycle with several steps (6-10 s), never a single step. A ONE-SHOT is one discrete action: hit, swing, click, cry, death, explosion, door, item, sting. DURATION: one-shots at least 2 s even for a tiny click, since shorter clips come out thin (hits, clicks and swings 2 s; cries, deaths, collapses and stings 3-5 s); movement loops 6-10 s; ambience, engine and fire loops 10-16 s. A music TRACK (Music folder) is not a sound effect: it is generated with generate_music and lasts up to the user's plan limit (generate_music duration_sec says it), usually 1-3 min for a theme and 30-60 s for a short loop. The server refuses one-shots under 2 s and loops under 6 s. COST = seconds rounded up × the account price per second (creditsPerSecond in list_games) × variations. The request can be in any language: the AI understands it and describes the sound for the generator (exact=true: translate only, literal). Returns the new variations (each with its editor link), the event page (url) and the game's studio (studioUrl). The game only plays chosen sounds: if the event has none yet, ALL the new variations become chosen and the game picks one at random (auto_choose=false turns this off; voice lines are never chosen automatically, generate them with generate_voice); an existing choice doesn't change. To switch or trim the list, use choose_sound.

auto_choose.description: true (default): if the event has no chosen sound yet, all the new variations become chosen and the game picks one at random. false leaves the choice to the user.

channels.description: Audio channels. auto (default): mono for everything the game positions (footsteps, hits, creatures, interface), stereo for Ambience backgrounds and for music in any folder. stereo: for a sound that does not come from a spot on the map (a sting, a screen whoosh). The choice is saved on the event.

duration_sec.description: One-shot at least 2 s; movement loops 6-10 s; ambience 10-16 s. A music track is generate_music, not this.

event_id.description: The event to generate in, from create_event, get_entity, find_sounds or list_folders.

exact.description: true = literal mode: only translates to English, without the AI filling out the description.

loop.description: true for anything continuous the game repeats (ambience, music, engines, fire, footsteps, running, flapping). Saved on the event.

prompt.description: Description of the sound, preferably in English.

variations.description: If omitted: 1 for a looping sound (ambience), 3 for everything else.

name: generate_sounds
title: Generate variations
